about_the_game:
The Rundown

The Majesty has overrun 90% of the dungeons. You remember the good old days where there were more goblins than humans - not any more. But thanks to the last surviving lich, your beloved queen, the Great Pearly One, your dwindling numbers can be bought back from the dead and resurrected into a guerilla war in which you have no choice but to WIN.

Under her order, you will perform a series of special operations in squads of four. This last stand against humanity is known as... The Ko-Ops.

GREEN TO THE BONE!
DEATH TO THE MAJESTY!

Reclaim the Dungeon

In Ko-Ops, you are the creatures in the dark, supplied by the Lich Queen's armory of guns and grenades. Massacre hordes of righteous adventurers with your surprisingly efficient modern tactical gear. Take down The Majesty before they raze the dungeon for good!

Finish the Mission

Thousands, and we mean thousands, of adventurers will come. Form up as a 1-4 player squad in an online hub world and plan and shoot your way through a variety of missions, including:

  • Infiltration

  • Heists

  • Search and Destroy

  • Assassinations

  • Wave Survival

Be a Dungeon Creature

Choose between one of four races with unique features and skill trees:

  • Goblin: Your typical dungeon rotbag. Well-rounded, squishable, and avid duct tape enthusiasts.

  • Kobold: Tiny, fast, and overdramatic when they take the smallest scratch. Stealthy, deadly and supportive.

  • Orc: Strong, armoured, and well-built. Like your typical action hero. Really enthusiastic about mashed potatoes.

  • Troll: Massive, slimy, and very hard to kill. Grown in labs. Certified crayon eater.

Lots to Master

Will you be a sharpshooter excellent at hitting headshots? Are you more of a melee brawler who masters blocking, parrying and chopping through foes? Or are you the cornerstone that supports your friends with health, ammo and buffs?

Between exciting gunplay, melee combat, and its tactical crafting elements - Ko-Ops does not skimp on any of its features. Try lots of playstyles and find your own; there are deep mechanics for everyone to master.

Craft em' Up Shooter

Resources and crafting is a weapon. Fell trees on adventurers and trigger explosive barrels to get the resources you need. Build shortcuts and barricades, tape together weapons, or create ammo and potions to keep your team alive.

Creatures of Shadow Stick Together

Work closely with your team. Discover unusual mechanics and customize an array of niche builds to claw your way through overwhelming odds.
